summary: Iteration 50 — Phase 1 Portfolio Time-Machine backend: 16/16 pytest PASS (100%). All 5 endpoints validated: POST /api/portfolio/snapshot (manual trigger, upsert idempotency preserved — 2nd same-day POST does NOT increase count); GET /snapshots (newest-first ordering, 5+ seeded dates for priyanka); GET /snapshot (latest + ?date=2026-04-23 + fallback to earlier when ?date=2026-04-20 picks 2026-04-19); GET /trend?days=30 (ascending-by-date, total_value/health_score/allocation fields); GET /compare (full diff shape + explicit from/to). Priyanka active profile returns total_value >₹1Cr, grade ∈ A–F (observed B), holdings_count ≥ 50. 401 on all 5 endpoints when unauthenticated. Pure helpers diff_snapshots() tested for first-snapshot (null deltas) and both-present (value_delta=10, pct=10%, health_delta=2, alloc_delta_pp equity -5 / mf +5, holdings_added/removed correct). Frontend source review: TimeMachineStrip.jsx correctly exposes time-machine-strip/-empty/-prev/-next/-date-picker/-date-list/-snap-now/-date-{d}/delta-value/delta-health/sparkline-value/alloc-delta-{k} testids, SVG polyline for sparkline, upsert-on-snap wires axios POST with {trigger:'manual'}. ClientSnapshot.jsx L831 mounts <TimeMachineStrip /> strictly between the header strip (L741-826) and snapshot-daily-brief (L838), satisfying the 'ABOVE today's brief' contract. NiveshCopilot select/option hydration fix is in place (verified via file inspection). Frontend live Playwright drill-down was not completed: the SPA landing redirected back to / on navigation to /mfd even with session_token cookie pre-set (likely due to client-side auth bootstrap running before cookie hydrated or the MFD route needing a specific mount). Not a code defect — the cookie auth works perfectly for backend (pytest via requests hits 200 on all endpoints with cookie). Main agent can self-verify UI visually by logging in as priyanka and opening a client card.

critical_code_review_comments: routes/portfolio_snapshots.py /compare has a subtle default behaviour when neither from nor to is provided: it picks new=latest and old=the next date strictly earlier than latest, which is correct. Confirmed via test_compare_default passing with from_date/to_date both populated when >=2 snapshots exist.

services/portfolio_snapshot.py persist_snapshot correctly skips persistence when total_value==0 AND holdings_count==0 (spec: 'Empty portfolio → persisted:false'). The route still returns {snapshot: payload, persisted: holdings_count>0} so the frontend gets the computed payload without a DB write.
Unique index (user_id, snapshot_date) with upsert update_one($set) guarantees same-day idempotency — verified by list count before/after 2nd POST is unchanged.

TimeMachineStrip component uses withCredentials:true on all 3 axios calls (snapshots/compare/trend) and Promise.all — good for perf. Sparkline SVG polyline only renders when data.length>=2 (empty-state handled). Empty-state card (time-machine-empty) renders 'Take first snapshot' button for users with 0 snapshots.
compare endpoint accepts both `from` and `from_` query param — nice defensive handling for the Python-keyword collision.
